name: musicdeck
description: Root convenience scripts for running the MusicDeck webapp and server together during local development.

scripts.start: concurrently -n server,webapp -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix webapp"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix webapp
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix webapp
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix webapp
